# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| TDDCycleRunner | src.agents.tdd_cycle_runner | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR TDD cycle with retries and learning loop |
| PythonLanguagePod | src.agents.python_language_pod | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD, wraps WorkerAgent or AutonomousTDDAgent |
| WorkerAgent | src.agents.worker_agent | LLM code-generation agent that builds prompts and extracts code |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src.agents.podman_orchestrator | Stateless sidecar execution for containerized test harness |
| PodmanRunner | src.agents.podman_runner | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |
| PlaybookManager | src.playbook.manager | Core playbook CRUD, delta updates, persistence, redundancy checking |
| ExperimentLogger | src.storage.experiment_logger | Unified logger for TDD/ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| LLMClient | src.utils.llm_client | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, Ollama, etc.) |
| Reflector | src.core.reflector.module | Analyzes generator performance, extracts error patterns and insights |
| Curator | src.core.curator.module | Synthesizes reflector insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src.core.generator.module | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM with bullet retrieval |
| BulletRetriever | src.playbook.retrieval | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| ImportFilter | src.agents.import_filter | Scans generated code for forbidden imports and builtins |
| ContextMapBuilder | src.utils.context_map | Builds AST-based context map from project files |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src.analytics.success_rate_calculator | Measures experiment success rates across types and versions |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src.analytics.token_efficiency | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod runs |
| PerformanceAggregator | src.broker.performance_aggregator | Extracts agent performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src.broker.adaptive_broker | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| AuditClient | src.audit.client | Write-only audit event emitter for agents |
| AuditStore | src.audit.store | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| EnsembleLearner | src.ensemble.learner | Orchestrates multi-model learning with cross-voting and deliberation |
| VotingSystem | src.ensemble.voting | Applies voting strategies (majority, supermajority, weighted, etc.) |
| BulletClusterer | src.playbook.clustering | DBSCAN-based clustering of semantically similar bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | src.playbook.deduplication | Semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src.retrieval.service | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src.retrieval.cgr3_retriever | CGR² pipeline: retrieve, rank, reason for context-aware bullet selection |
| ContextScorer | src.retrieval.context_scorer | Scores bullets against request context across multiple dimensions |
| TDDLessonInjector | src.agents.tdd_lesson_injector | Injects TDD lessons into prompts based on development phase |
| TestReviewAgent | src.agents.test_review_agent | Validates test quality before implementation |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src.agents.autonomous_tdd_agent | Original autonomous TDD agent (legacy, used by PythonLanguagePod) |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src.agents.polyglot_tdd_runner | Drives TDD loop across multiple LanguagePods for different languages |
| GoLanguagePod | src.agents.go_language_pod | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD |
| ContractArchitect | src.contracts.contract_architect | Generates interface contracts from natural language requirements |
| ModuleArchitect | src.contracts.module_architect | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | src.agents.gherkin_extraction_agent | Reverse engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client as Client (run_cycle.py)
    participant Runner as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Cont as PodmanRunner (Container)
    participant Log as ExperimentLogger
    participant PB as PlaybookManager
    participant RC as Reflector+Curator

    Client->>Runner: run(spec)
    activate Runner

    Runner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
    activate Pod
    Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
    activate Worker
    Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
    activate LLM
    LLM-->>Worker: code
    deactivate LLM
    Worker-->>Pod: test_code
    deactivate Worker
    Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file: code})
    activate Orch
    Orch->>Cont: send_pulse(files)
    activate Cont
    Cont-->>Orch: raw_response
    deactivate Cont
    Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
    deactivate Orch
    alt RED aborted (security/policy failure)
        Pod-->>Runner: PhaseResult(error)
        Runner-->>Client: CycleResult(success=False, abort)
        deactivate Runner
        Note right of Runner: exits if error starts with ForbiddenImport/SecurityBreach/Bandit gate
    else RED passed (failing test written)
        Pod-->>Runner: PhaseResult(passed=False, output)
    end
    deactivate Pod

    loop up to max_green_attempts times
        Runner->>Pod: run_green(retry_spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: code
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
        activate Orch
        Orch->>Cont: send_pulse(files)
        activate Cont
        Cont-->>Orch: raw_response
        deactivate Cont
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orch
        alt GREEN passed
            Pod-->>Runner: PhaseResult(passed=True)
            break
        else GREEN failed and not abort
            Pod-->>Runner: PhaseResult(passed=False, output)
        end
        deactivate Pod
    end

    alt GREEN failed after retries
        Runner-->>Client: CycleResult(success=False, error)
        deactivate Runner
    else GREEN succeeded
        Runner->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
        activate Orch
        Orch->>Cont: send_pulse(files)
        activate Cont
        Cont-->>Orch: raw_response
        deactivate Cont
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orch
        Pod-->>Runner: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod

        Runner->>Log: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        activate Log
        Log-->>Runner: ok
        deactivate Log

        opt learning enabled (reflector+curator present)
            Runner->>RC: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            activate RC
            RC->>RC: reflect() -> ReflectorOutput
            RC->>RC: curate() -> CuratorOutput
            RC->>PB: apply_delta(delta_bullets)
            activate PB
            PB-->>RC: added_bullet_ids
            deactivate PB
            RC-->>Runner: learned_bullets
            deactivate RC
        end

        Runner-->>Client: CycleResult(success=True)
    end
    deactivate Runner
```
